blocks.text: 港邊　霓虹燈閃熾　暗暝九如路　稍誇稀微
blocks.spelling: káng-pinn ne-hóng-ting siám sik àm-mî kiú-jû lōo sio khua hi-bî

blocks.text: 賭強　拷手槍過日子　解消憂愁　吹喇叭聲音
blocks.spelling: tóo-kiông khao tshiú-tshìng kuè li̍t-tsí kái siau iu-tshiû pûn lá-pah siann-im

blocks.text: 房間內　月娘藏海底
blocks.spelling: pâng-king-lāi ge̍h-niû tshàng hái-té

blocks.text: 後門打開　毒龍鑽入我的心
blocks.spelling: āu-mn̂g phah-khui to̍k liông tsǹg li̍p guá ê sim

blocks.text: 窗外的雨　衛生紙擦未離
blocks.spelling: thang-guā ê hōo uē-sing tsuá tshit buē lī

blocks.text: 原諒我　剩滿身胭脂味
blocks.spelling: guân-liōng guá tshun muá-sin ian-tsi bī

blocks.text: 溫柔招數　體貼手路
blocks.spelling: un-jiû tsiau-sòo thé-thiap tshiú-lōo

blocks.text: 乎人忘記社會約束
blocks.spelling: hōo lâng buē-kì siā-huē iok-sok

blocks.text: 別管人笑阮開查某
blocks.spelling: bàng-kuán lâng tshiò gún khai tsa-bóo

blocks.text: 半套的愛　全部出來　冰火上天
blocks.spelling: puànn thò ê ài tsuân-pōo tshut-lâi ping hué tshiūnn-thinn

blocks.text: 滿面春風　踏著輕鬆的腳步
blocks.spelling: muá-bīn tshun-hong ta̍h-tio̍h khin-sang ê kha-pōo

blocks.text: 我為妳痴迷放捨一切
blocks.spelling: guá uî lí tshi-bê pàng sánn it-tshè

blocks.text: 看做是無緣的眠夢　莫奈何
